notes: Written against the mock's v1 layout. Switching the mock to v2 breaks most of these on purpose; the repair loop rewrites them.

rent.description: Monthly rent (number field) on step 'The room'

available_date.description: Available from (date field) on step 'The room'

min_stay.description: Minimum stay (select field) on step 'The room'

private_bath.description: Private bathroom (checkbox field) on step 'The room'

next_1.description: 'Next step' button that advances from step 'The room' to the next step

address.description: Street or neighborhood (text field) on step 'The place'

headline.description: Listing headline (text field) on step 'The place'

description.description: Describe your place (textarea field) on step 'The place'

next_2.description: 'Next step' button that advances from step 'The place' to the next step

photos.description: Room photos (photo upload file input) on step 'Photos'

next_3.description: 'Next step' button that advances from step 'Photos' to the next step

publish.description: final 'Publish listing' button on the review step that makes the listing public (NEVER clicked on live sites)

posted.description: confirmation box shown after publishing, carries data-listing-id

thread_row.description: one row per conversation in the inbox list; an attribute on it holds the thread id (t1234)

message.description: one element per chat message in an open thread; an attribute holds the message id (m1234), another says who wrote it

reply_box.description: message composer text box in an open thread

send_button.description: button that sends the typed reply
